attributes.board_name: South Carolina Board of Examiners in Speech-Language Pathology and Audiology (SC LLR)

rules.accepted_credit_types: Courses by ASHA or AAA CE sponsors; SC Academy of Audiology, SCSHA, NIHIS, Academy of Rehabilitative Audiology, American Auditory Society, Academy of Dispensing Audiology, NBASLH or other Board-approved organization; graduate courses within scope (1 semester hour = 15 hours = 1.5 CEUs); state or federal agency courses within scope; online courses allowed; instructors get equal credit once per course. Max 2 hours independent study with Board approval 60 days in advance.
rules.audit_note: Licensees attest at renewal; keep records 4 years; the Board may audit biennially. Deficient hours found on audit must be remedied within 60 days or the license lapses.
rules.notes: Statute converts 16 hours = 1.6 CEUs (1 CEU = 10 hours). At least half of the hours must relate to clinical practice in the area of licensure. Licenses renew biennially and expire March 31 of the second year. Intern licensees need 8 hours (0.8 CEUs) per license period. No mandatory topics. The Board's LLR website could not be opened from our location; numbers come from the statute and regulations.
rules.rule_quote: (A) As a condition of license renewal, a speech-language pathologist or audiologist shall satisfactorily complete sixteen hours of approved continuing education or 1.6 continuing education units (CEUs) during each license period.

rules.accepted_credit_types: Same course rules as for licensees (S.C. Code Regs. 115-6).
rules.audit_note: Attest at renewal; keep records 4 years; subject to biennial audit.
rules.notes: Speech-language pathology assistant licenses renew biennially (expire March 31 of the second year). At least half of the hours must relate to clinical practice.
rules.rule_quote: (C) As a condition of an assistant license renewal, a speech-language pathology assistant shall satisfactorily complete eight hours of approved continuing education or 0.8 CEUs during each license period.
